items.statement: CEO resigned for a better opportunity; company will operate with business heads instead of a CEO
items.quote: No. I mean, no known reason to me. What was known is what was disclosed. He found a better opportunity, he moved on. That is what we know. And we don't intend to get a new CEO.

items.statement: Cash flow from operations was INR 132.4 crores for March '26
items.quote: Our cash flow from operations was INR 132.4 crores for March '26.

items.statement: Promoter holding increased by 2% in March 2026; management declined to comment on further increase plans.
items.quote: So we increased our promoter holding by 2% in March month. So are you planning to increase it more? Yash Parekh: So we can't comment on this, Manan, unfortunately. But clearly at this stage whatever we have purchased is in public domain

items.statement: Board approved a preferential issue of INR35 crores, with INR15 crores subscribed by promoter group via convertible warrants and INR20 crores from non-promoter investors.
items.quote: Sharing thoughts on the capital structure, we recently raised, our board recently approved a preferential issue of INR35 crores, which was largely to fund the growth and take up a 4.5 lakh square feet with Winston as an asset.

items.statement: Board approved a non-convertible debenture issuance of INR100 crores at project level to optimize financing mix.
items.quote: The board has also approved a non- convertible debenture issuance at a project level to further optimize our financing mix.

items.statement: Expects a liquidity event of INR110-120 crores in Q1 FY27 from monetization of subsidiary holding building 0.5 million sq ft.
items.quote: Q1 FY27, we are anticipating a significant capital event through monetization of our holding in one of our subsidiaries, wherein we are building almost 0.5 million square feet. That capital event would result into a liquidity of INR110 crores to INR120 crores within DevX.

items.statement: Expects cash EBIT margin of 21-22% at a revenue run rate of INR330-350 crores in FY27.
items.quote: So next year, at a revenue run rate of 330 to 350 Crores, we expect to have a cash EBIT of 21 to 22 percentage.

items.statement: Negative operating cash flow in FY26 due to MSME payment terms and Konica Minolta advance payments; collections strong in Q1 FY27 and position normalized
items.quote: We reported negative operating cash flow for the year and this requires some explanation. A majority of our vendor base qualifies as MSME suppliers and the regulatory framework governing MSME payment mandate settlement within 45 days. In FY26, we meaningfully scaled up volume with several of these vendors, where the majority of supply was previously imported under credit term existing well beyond

items.statement: New auditor raised qualifications in Q4 FY25; all resolved over past 12 months and qualifications withdrawn
items.quote: Upon coming on board, they undertook a comprehensive review of our financial statements, internal controls and accounting processes and had raised certain observations and qualifications in the quarter 4 of FY'25 audit report.

items.statement: Non-compliance with Section 186(7) on non-interest-bearing loans to subsidiaries; Rs 112 crore of Rs 117 crore converted to equity by year-end
items.quote: The first matter pertains to non -compliance with Section 186(7) of the Companies Act, 20 13, relating to certain non -interest-bearing loans extended to subsidiaries. I am pleased to share that the majority of these loans amounting to Rs. 112 crore out of total Rs. 117 crore had already been converted into equity by end of the financial year.

items.statement: GST input tax credit differences reconciled, physical verification of assets completed, ECL provision made on trade receivables and unbilled revenues
items.quote: We completed the reconciliation of input tax credit differences, carried out comprehensive physical verification exercises and made the ne cessary adjustments required in this regard, resulting in a one-time additional provision during the year.

items.statement: RBI approval pending for loan-to-equity conversion of US subsidiary acquisition; expected in next 2 quarters
items.quote: There are certain procedures that we have to get done through the RBI and get the approval of the RBI. The process for that has started. We are pretty sure generally, it takes about a quarter or 2. So in next 2 quarters, we should be able to get a clean sheet coming in from everywhere.

items.statement: Consolidated cash as of 31st March was ₹1,362 million and net cash was ₹590 million after outstanding debt
items.quote: The consolidated cash as of 31st March was ₹1,362 million, and the net cash was ₹590 million after considering outstanding debt.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased to INR 162 crores from INR 115 crores due to higher ad revenue and Dhurandhar release timing
items.quote: One of the key reasons for the increase is that advertisement sales typically have a realization cycle of anywhere between 110 to 150 or even 160 days, depending on whether the client belongs to the corporate or government segment.

items.statement: Consolidated DSO for current year stands at 147 days compared to 121 days in FY25
items.quote: To give you some perspective on DSOs, or Days Sales Outstanding, the consolidated DSO for the current year stands at 147 days, compared to 121 days in FY25, and this increase is largely attributable to the reasons I just mentioned.

items.statement: Net cash improved from INR 48.3 crores to INR 59 crores during the year despite INR 11 crores tied up in working capital
items.quote: Our net cash has improved from INR 48.3 crores to INR 59 crores during the year, despite nearly INR 11 crores getting further tied up in working capital.

items.statement: Management highlighted working capital management through inventory optimization and assortment focus as a key driver of growth.
items.quote: as part of working capital management, the number one point was in terms of managin g our assortment. So last year, there was extensive work done in H1 in terms of our optimization of our inventory, which started with looking at our assortment design or assortment strategy and looking at optimizing our SKU mix with a focus on, (a) lowering inventory at an aggregate level, but more importantly, put

items.statement: Management stated the mandate is to achieve EBITDA breakeven first, after which recapitalization options including equity infusion will be evaluated.
items.quote: The mandate to the management team is to do an EBITDA turnaround. And therefore, we are focused in terms of ensuring that we breakeven at the EBITDA level. I'm sure the moment that happens, that is a strong signal to everyone. And at that point of time, we will look at how do we recapitalize.

items.statement: Free cash flow for FY26 was negative three crores.
items.quote: free cash flow for FY26 was negative three crores cash and cash equivalent stood at 89.2 crores.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents stood at 89.2 crores net of buyback completed in H1 FY26.
items.quote: Cash equivalence stood at 89.2 crores so please note that this is net of the buyback that was completed in H1 FY26.

items.statement: Management expects to be eligible for another buyback soon and intends to continue buybacks as a way to return cash to shareholders.
items.quote: we had done a buyback last year, and then we'll probably be eligible for doing another buyback soon. So, you know, probably once that window opens up, we would be, you know, as we mentioned that we would want to sort of keep doing buyback

items.statement: Construction chemicals DSO around 88 days as on 31st March 2026
items.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31 st of March 2026

items.statement: Distribution business DSO roughly 80 days as on 31st March 2026
items.quote: here also we are maintaining a tight credit policy with days sales outstanding at 80 days, roughly as on 31 st of March 2026

items.statement: Operating cash flow turned negative in FY26 due to higher working capital from strategic advance payments to vendors and inventory build-up amid supply chain uncertainty.
items.quote: while the company delivered healthy revenue last year, our operating cash flow was impacted mainly due to higher working capital during the year.

name: Star Imaging And Path Lab Ltd

items.statement: Operating cash flow improved to INR23.4 crores in FY26 from negative INR2.6 crores in FY25
items.quote: Operating cash flow improved significantly to INR23.4 crores compared to the negative operating cash flow that we had in the last year, INR22.6 crores in FY25.

items.statement: Company remains debt-free and inventories reduced during the year
items.quote: The company continues to remain debt-free in its operations. During the year, the inventories reduced as the company was able to increase its market share and add new customers to its fold, which helped in overall material balance.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was Rs747m for FY26, below the 5-year average of ~Rs1,000m, due to receivables and inventory increases.
items.quote: All this resulted in generation of strong operating cash flows at Rs747m for FY26.

items.statement: Management expects operating cash flow of over Rs1,000m for FY27 as receivables and inventory normalize in 1H FY27.
items.quote: We expect to deliver OCF of over Rs1,000m for FY27.

items.statement: Trade receivables rose to Rs3,503m in Q4 FY26 from Rs2,753m in Q4 FY25, driven by shifting of content licensing collections and Middle East collection delays.
items.quote: Trade Receivables increased to Rs3,503m during Q4FY26 vs Rs2,753m during Q4FY25.

items.statement: Inventory increased to Rs1,634m in Q4 FY26 from Rs1,401m in Q4 FY25 due to higher finished goods from NCF rollout.
items.quote: Inventory increased to Rs1,634m (vs Q4FY25: Rs1,401m).

items.statement: Net cash balance stood at Rs1,048m at end of FY26 after capex of Rs362m and acquisition outgo of Rs107m.
items.quote: We achieved profit growth of 21% and ended the year with PAT of Rs731m. 6. The company continues to build on its net debt free status company at the end of FY26 with a net Cash balance of Rs1,048m, despite a Capex of 362 Mn and Acquisition Outgo of 107 Mn

items.statement: Management expects net cash of around Rs130-135 crore next year after ~Rs20 crore capex.
items.quote: Considering we have a capex of about Rs20 crores coming up, I would say, we should be around Rs130 crores, Rs135 crores.

items.statement: CRSIL rating upgraded from BBB to BBB+ validating company performance
items.quote: I am also happy to announce that the rating agency, C RSIL, has increased our rating from BBB to BBB+, which validates us as a standpoint of a company which is very promising

items.statement: Inventory increased to 100 crore and is expected to increase further with growth
items.quote: As I said previously also that if you increase your turnover, everything will increase. You know, if you are going for a further growth, inventory will further increase.

items.statement: Working capital intensity increased due to high growth in micro-irrigation and solar pumps; expects stabilization in FY27 with substantial receivable recoveries
items.quote: So because of the high growth, definitely this year the working capital intensity has increased. But we are expecting that this should stabilize in the current year as there are substantial recoveries in both the business segments, especially on the receivable side.

items.statement: Consolidated net cash flow dropped from ₹53 crore to ₹30 crore year-on-year; management deferred detailed explanation to email follow-up.
items.quote: The consolidated net cash flow generated from last year to this year , last year it was around ₹53 crore, and this year almost ₹30 crore. Why this much of a drop? Is it because we are not able to collect cash from dealers? What steps are we taking to improve this cash flow?

items.statement: Management expects working capital days to fall below 200 days by FY28–29 as volumes increase and model range stabilizes.
items.quote: It should come under 200 days.

items.statement: IPO proceeds used to repay loans, improving current ratio to 2.39
items.quote: Finally, after the IPO process, the IPO amount that came in was used to repay loans, due to which the current ratio has also improved. It has been 2.39, wh ich reflects a strong equity position for us, which is very big for us right now

items.statement: Operating cash flows increased sharply to 103.6 crore in FY26
items.quote: Operating cash flows increased sharply to 103.6 CR.

items.statement: Free cash flow generated in FY26 was around 42.28 crore
items.quote: So the free cash flows for generated in the previous year was around 42.28 crores.

items.statement: CMD says 7,800 ton capacity addition requires roughly INR35 crores.
items.quote: No, 7,800 tons, we require roughly INR35 crores.

items.statement: CMD says next year (FY28) capex for 2,400 tons LFC will be around INR60 to INR70 crores.
items.quote: next year when we go for a bigger project, that is for 2,400 tons, that time we are looking at investment of say around INR60 crores to INR70 crores.

items.statement: CMD says FY27 capex will be funded by debt only; FY28 capex by combination of debt and equity.
items.quote: This year it will be by debt-only, and next year will be by debt and equity.
